# temps_settings (Resource)

Instance-wide Temps settings, as one JSON document in `values` that is merged into the stored settings: keys you leave out keep their current value, and refresh only compares the keys you set. Secrets Temps masks on read (registry passwords, DNS tokens) cannot be compared and are taken as unchanged.

Destroying the resource leaves the settings as they are; it only stops managing them.

Import with `settings`.

Required API key permissions: `settings:read`, `settings:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_settings" "this" {
  values = jsonencode({
    preview_domain  = "preview.example.com"
    image_retention = { enabled = true, default_hours = 336 }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `values` (String) Settings to apply, using the field names of `GET /api/settings`, for example `jsonencode({ preview_domain = "preview.example.com", security_headers = { enabled = true } })`. A JSON document; use `jsonencode(...)`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `settings`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Singleton: the import ID is the resource type without the prefix.
terraform import temps_settings.this settings
```
